# R5.42 — Per-stage readiness and full exposure quote

Implements `docs/tickets/212_R5.42__quote.md` (seq 212 of 246) —
the M-I slice: `build_quote(&QuoteDecl) ->
Result<ExposureQuote, QuoteError>`, a pure/total records-in
quote builder that validates the **supplied** binding inputs
(every value an external gated input bound by HUMAN-H8 and the
stage gates, never chosen here) and yields the deterministic
`exposure-quote/1` packet — per-stage readiness
(`ready_for_gate | blocked{blockers} | infeasible`), the full
exposure worksheet (subjects `N = 2TR ≥ 10T`,
retries/regrades/instruments/unknown exposure/prices/resources/
full archive/versions/backups/retention across both runners,
policies, endpoints and strata), the structurally distinct
`ab_subjects`/`ho_pairs` counts (300 A/B subjects are not 300
H/O pairs), and attainable-precision diagnostics at η = .025 —
sealed under a derived `quote_id` commitment minted last inside
one `Result`. Engineered machinery only — no participant data,
no live execution, no input/price/margin choice, no spend, no
scientific claim.

Requirement ids stamped: **REQ-D-105, REQ-D-110, REQ-D-309,
REQ-C-105, REQ-C-106, REQ-C-004** (primary); contributing only:
none — no second primary owner.

## What changed

- `crates/hh-eval/src/exposure_quote.rs` — the builder:
  five closed vocabularies (`STAGES` 5 — diagnostic is not a
  quoted stage; `PREREQUISITES` 7; `PINS` 18 incl.
  `endpoint_map`/`backend`/`rights` mapping onto AC-2's
  `map`/`backend`/`rights` blocker words; `COMPONENTS` 23
  worksheet lines; `ENVELOPE_COMPONENTS` 11 capability bounds);
  refusal-first ordering — every refusal gate runs before
  packets compute and `quote_id = idp_digest("exposure_quote",
  canonical(record minus id))` is minted last inside one
  `Result`, no prefix an admitted state. Closed `QuoteError`
  (23 variants): `MissingKey`, stage/pin/prereq/component/
  envelope/endpoint vocabularies + duplicates, `EnvelopeExceeded`
  vs the frozen §9.2 ceilings (pilot ≤60 subjects/≤200 core-h/
  ≤50 GiB + eight per-subject caps; confirmation ≤300/≤900 core-h/
  ≤200 GiB/≤14 d; parity/replication quote-only), `SubjectFloor`
  (`2TR < 10T`), `CountMismatch`/`CountConflation`,
  `ActivationShape`, `RunnerSet`/`PolicySet`, `AutomaticTopUp`,
  `PooledCapacity`, `CloudFallback`, `GuessedMargin`,
  `FavorableShopping`, `ExposureMalformed`. Blockers are typed and
  per-stage — unbound pins, unpriced/unquoted/unbounded exposure
  cells, unset bounds, unresolved margins, unmet prerequisites and
  unset currency ($0) block only the dependent action; dispatch is
  `not_requested | refused{first blocker} | gate_pending{GATE-G12/
  G13/G14/unscheduled}` — never an authorization.
- `crates/hh-eval/tests/r5_42.rs` — 17-test battery: positive
  complete-packet/determinism/counts/precision legs (§4.5
  N = 150 η = .025 half-widths {.024293,.042944,.065355,.100601,
  .190899} ±2ppm) and the full typed-negative union, incl. the two
  pass-2 close-review legs.
- ADR-0420 (landing decisions + refusal vocabulary; dated
  2026-11-03 amendment note for the pass-2 self-review repairs).
- `docs/build/runs/R5.42.md` — run ledger with the per-target
  coverage mapping (engineered D/E achieved; R/P + actual-execution
  E stay owed to HUMAN-H8, GATE-G18/R5.42a, GATE-G11–G14, R5.47,
  R5.49 — evidence dependency, never dispatch).

## Deviation (conspicuous)

**2,152 changed source/test lines vs the ≤600 trigger (~3.6×)** —
2,029 (~3.4×) measured at the `978cea78` checkpoint stop plus 123
pass-2 close-review repair lines (same closed predicate; the
refusal surface only grew). Recorded Deviation, accepted per the
scoped **AMEND** ruling `f2480bc8`
(`docs/build/planning/2026-11-03_R5.42-split-review.md`): the M-I
methods packet binds the readiness/quote packet to one owner with
no written contingency; `build_quote` is one closed predicate
(every refusal gate before compute; `quote_id` minted last; no
prefix admitted); L150's four weak seams consumed or inter-ticket;
all three proposed cuts fail (impl-vs-battery non-curative,
decl-vs-compute mid-predicate, per-stage splits AC-1's five-stage
conjunct). **~3.4× is a new build high-water mark — exceeding the
prior ~3.0× band (R5.29 ~3.02× / R5.38 ~3.0×)** — the AMEND is
recorded explicitly as a fresh high-water Deviation, not a silent
band extension. Stopped correctly at the trigger; honest trip:
review, not redesign.

## Design decisions

- hh-eval is the spine's cycle-free home — it consumes the parity
  `DIMENSIONS` vocabulary, `directional_kl::ETA_TOST_PPM`,
  `stats::kl_directional_bound` and the S.1 `MethodMetadata`
  contract unchanged; no new dependency/RecordKind/event class/
  wire name/kernel arm (I-01/I-02); ops-cell and rights/handoff
  evidence travel by ref (records-in — ADR-0420 D1).
- Precision is diagnostic, never power: the parity stage computes
  `kl_directional_bound` at η = .025 over `{0} ∪` declared
  discordances; each bound margin yields
  `attainable | infeasible | unresolved` (sticky severity —
  pass-2 repair), `infeasible` is a stage state, never a waiver.
- Readiness is honest: unset currency prices $0 (`total_micros=0`)
  and blocks `funding`; unbound/unpriced/unbounded inputs block
  only the dependent action — the packet still builds, echoes
  every input verbatim, and names each blocker (informative when
  incomplete).
- Forbidden constructs refuse at construction — `top_up`,
  `pool_from`, `assumed_margin`, `cloud_fallback`,
  `outcome_conditioned` are typed `Err`, never warnings; envelope
  ceilings stop/requote, never silently widen.
